create_VisionEncoder: create a VisionEncoder module that encodes images into spatial and vector features using a ViT backbone
create_TextEncoder: create a TextEncoder module that encodes token IDs into embeddings using a transformer stack
build_VisionEncoder_pool_features: build a VisionEncoder and extract spatial patch features and CLS token vector embeddings from encoded features
build_VisionEncoder_reshape_spatial_feat: build a VisionEncoder and reshape spatial features from flat token sequence back to 2D grid dimensions
test_TextEncoder_call: test the TextEncoder __call__ method with token IDs, paddings, and training flag to produce pooled embeddings
